top_signals.title: US Stocks Open Flat as Focus Turns to Chipmaker Earnings, CPI
top_signals.summary: US stocks were little changed at market open on Monday as investors gear up for the final stretch of earnings. Earnings this week from chipmakers could provide confirmation for the long-winded debate over chip valuations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Healthcare software company Unlimited Technology Systems reported that more than 3.8 million people were impacted by a data breach incident that occurred in October 2025. [...]

top_signals.title: Glencore Consortium Offers Rival Bid for Troubled Canadian Miner
top_signals.summary: A consortium including Glencore Plc proposed a rescue deal for troubled Canadian miner Sherritt International Corp., offering a potential alternative to an earlier plan from an ally of US President Donald Trump.

top_signals.title: When Credentials Are No Longer Enough: Device Trust in the AI Era
top_signals.summary: AI is making phishing, credential theft, and social engineering faster and more efficient, while traditional trust signals such as passwords, MFA, IP reputation, and geolocation become easier to bypass. Specops explains why organizations are increasingly adding device trust to their Zero Trust strategies. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
